title: High volume days
statementMd:
Count price rows where volume exceeded 800,000.

Expected columns: `busy_days`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS busy_days FROM prices WHERE volume > 800000;
```
